statement.zh: 特罗（吉尔苏）在 1877–1933 年间约二十季法国发掘出土建筑与器物；Parrot 1948 综合季史与已刊材料。吉尔苏与希巴（拉格什本城）不得混为一处。
statement.en: At Tello (Girsu), about twenty French excavation campaigns between 1877 and 1933 recovered architecture and finds; Parrot 1948 synthesizes campaign history and published materials. Girsu remains distinct from Tell al-Hiba (Lagash city proper).

editorial.notes: Fact about excavation history as synthesized by Parrot. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: campaign finds first; site distinction kept.
